ten_k_highlights: Our products are designed to provide high-speed, low-power connectivity solutions for data center and cloud networking applications.
We have a strong product roadmap, with multiple new products in development, including 400G and 800G products.
Our revenue growth is expected to be driven by increasing demand for high-speed connectivity solutions in the data center and cloud markets.
